messages:
maria_v: quick FYI — found a regression from yesterday's RBAC refactor that appears to let users from one org enumerate projects in other orgs. repro attached, pretty small.
maria_v: steps: 1) use a user in org A, 2) call GET /v1/projects?owner=org_b_id, 3) returns list from org B. :eyes:
maria_v: reproduction snippet:
```
GET /api/projects?org=org_b_id
Authorization: Bearer <token for user@orgA>
```

ajay_p: whoa. do we know root cause yet? policy mapping change? :fire:

maria_v: looks like the policy evaluation middleware uses `claims.org` in some paths and `claims.org_id` in others after the refactor. when the request has workspace_id set it falls back to resource.workspace instead of enforcing owner_org equality.

sam_k: can you paste the failing policy snippet you saw? small one-liner is fine.

maria_v: here — the old check was:
```
allow if resource.owner_org == request.user.claims["org_id"]
```
and the new code accidentally does:
```
allow if resource.workspace == request.user.claims["workspace_id"] || resource.owner_org == request.user.claims["org"]
```
so org vs org_id mismatch plus fallback made it permissive for certain project objects that had empty owner_org.

leo: that explains it. some of our migrations left owner_org NULL for migrated projects. when owner_org is NULL the workspace path matched and allowed access.

ajay_p: scope please — how many orgs or projects affected? any known customer impact yet?

maria_v: preliminary DB query (postgres):
```
SELECT count(*), coalesce(owner_org,'<null>') as owner_org
FROM projects
GROUP BY coalesce(owner_org,'<null>')
```
shows ~1200 projects with owner_org NULL across many orgs. rough estimate: ~30 orgs touched. i'm running more targeted queries now.

sam_k: run this to enumerate potentially exposed projects:
```
SELECT id, name, workspace, owner_org
FROM projects
WHERE owner_org IS NULL AND workspace IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 200;
```

maria_v: also noticed audit logs for these cross-org ListProjects calls are sparse — requests lack actor_org in the structured payload. KMS decrypt logs also don't show key access for some tokens (weird).

leo: KMS bit — could be because service that proxies requests isn't forwarding the principal properly after the refactor. check Cloud KMS/CloudTrail for Decrypt events for the service account used by the API gateway.

maria_v: example GCP logging query I used:
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND jsonPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --limit 50
```
and an AWS CloudTrail one-liner for other regions:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --max-results 50
```

ajay_p: immediate mitigation suggestions?

sam_k: I recommend three steps now:
1) hotfix policy evaluation to fail-closed on owner_org mismatch (block workspace fallback), push canary to prod region A only.
2) backfill owner_org for NULL projects from workspace -> org mapping where safe.
3) rotate affected internal service tokens if any service account was used to proxy auth.

leo: I'll prepare a minimal patch: change middleware to require owner_org equality before any workspace-path fallback and add extra logging for org claims missing. will open PR referencing this thread.

maria_v: +1 to that. also we need to run scoped audit to find external customers who queried other org ids. add query on request logs for GET /api/projects where query param org != request.user.claims.org_id.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0192. Severity: high. Pager duty notified. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0192 :lock:

ajay_p: good. communication: do we notify customers proactively? legal & trust should weigh in. set up a brief for CSMs.

sam_k: i'll draft a short internal summary and a recommended customer notification template — keep wording conservative until we confirm exposure.

leo: rolling the hotfix to prod-canary in 10m, will monitor logs for any 403 -> 200 flips. tagging @ops for watch.

maria_v: timeline: discovered 09:46, PR in 10:05, canary 10:20. will post updates here. thanks for fast responses. :thumbsup:

ajay_p: after hotfix, run the list of access events for the last 24h. if we see cross-org reads, enumerate affected org IDs, compile list for legal.

maria_v: logging note: add owner_org and actor_org to structured audit entries for project reads, and ensure KMS key usage logs include principalEmail. follow-up tickets created.

security-bot: Addendum: created task SE-1429 to backfill owner_org and SE-1430 to enhance audit payloads.
